properties.name: spring.activemq.broker-url
properties.description: URL of the ActiveMQ broker. Auto-generated by default.

properties.name: spring.activemq.close-timeout
properties.description: Time to wait before considering a close complete.

properties.name: spring.activemq.embedded.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable embedded mode if the ActiveMQ Broker is available.

properties.name: spring.activemq.non-blocking-redelivery
properties.description: Whether to stop message delivery before re-delivering messages from a rolled back transaction. This implies that message order is not preserved when this is enabled.

properties.name: spring.activemq.packages.trust-all
properties.description: Whether to trust all packages.

properties.name: spring.activemq.packages.trusted
properties.description: List of specific packages to trust (when not trusting all packages).

properties.name: spring.activemq.password
properties.description: Login password of the broker.

properties.name: spring.activemq.pool.block-if-full
properties.description: Whether to block when a connection is requested and the pool is full. Set it to false to throw a "JMSException" instead.

properties.name: spring.activemq.pool.block-if-full-timeout
properties.description: Blocking period before throwing an exception if the pool is still full.

properties.name: spring.activemq.pool.enabled
properties.description: Whether a JmsPoolConnectionFactory should be created, instead of a regular ConnectionFactory.

properties.name: spring.activemq.pool.idle-timeout
properties.description: Connection idle timeout.

properties.name: spring.activemq.pool.max-connections
properties.description: Maximum number of pooled connections.

properties.name: spring.activemq.pool.max-sessions-per-connection
properties.description: Maximum number of pooled sessions per connection in the pool.

properties.name: spring.activemq.pool.time-between-expiration-check
properties.description: Time to sleep between runs of the idle connection eviction thread. When negative, no idle connection eviction thread runs.

properties.name: spring.activemq.pool.use-anonymous-producers
properties.description: Whether to use only one anonymous "MessageProducer" instance. Set it to false to create one "MessageProducer" every time one is required.

properties.name: spring.activemq.send-timeout
properties.description: Time to wait on message sends for a response. Set it to 0 to wait forever.

properties.name: spring.activemq.user
properties.description: Login user of the broker.

properties.name: spring.activemq.pool.create-connection-on-startup
properties.description: Whether to create a connection on startup. Can be used to warm up the pool on startup.

properties.name: spring.activemq.pool.expiry-timeout
properties.description: Connection expiration timeout.

properties.name: spring.activemq.pool.reconnect-on-exception
properties.description: Reset the connection when a "JMSException" occurs.
